transcript.text: Thank you, everyone. Here are my accounting findings. While reviewing the bond terms this week, I determined that the contractual cash flows include a contingent step-up feature. This is significant because it means the position does not meet the SPPI test — solely payments of principal and interest — required for classification at amortized cost. As a result, the position must be recorded at fair value through profit or loss rather than held at amortized cost. My accounting memo detailing this conclusion is awaiting circulation and has not yet been distributed to the committee packet. The practical implication is that this position would be measured at fair value on an ongoing basis, with changes in fair value flowing through profit and loss each reporting period. This is different from an amortized-cost classification, where the position would be carried at cost less impairment. I want the committee to be aware of this before the vote, as it affects how this position will appear in our financial statements and how unrealized gains or losses will impact reported earnings over the 30-month holding period.
